capabilities: render a radial map of notes by recency, intensity and entity type
rank notes by an attention score computed from edits, mentions, backlinks and opens
open notes from the map or the ranked list
toggle between all notes and entities only across 7, 14 and 30 day ranges
write the computed attention ranking to a local JSON file for scripts or other plugins
disambiguation: Not a focus timer or distraction blocker; it is a radial map of which notes your attention recently touched.
extras: Marked beta with a note that rough edges are expected. Writes a per-device JSON ranking under .icor-for-life/icor-for-life-focus/ and logs note opens locally (pruned after 35 days); makes no network connections.
intentEvidence: A graph view shows you the shape of your vault. That is interesting once and then never again
motivation: The author wanted a view that answers what you actually worked on recently rather than what you remember doing, since the standard graph's shape barely changes day to day.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows a mostly static vault shape, so it does not reveal where your attention has actually gone recently.

relations.evidence: Part of the ICOR for Life suite.

summary: Recency-based attention map that places recently worked-on notes near the center, sized by intensity and colored by entity type, with a ranked score list.
